snippet.title: Hungry Meem | 2nd Trailer
snippet.description:
*The video is from a product under development.

Brand new colony simulation game “Hungry Meem” 
Nintendo Switch version: June 19, 2025 (Thursday)
Steam version: July 31, 2025 (Thursday)
Release!

*The 2nd Trailer for the updated release date of the Steam version is here.
https://youtu.be/Ci-muwu_3Tc?feature=shared

This game features a unique game system in which players train AI characters “Meems” and breed over generations to explore dungeons. This attractive game experience is created by Kenichi Nishi's (“Chibi-Robo!” “moon”) original concept and Yulihito Morikawa's (“Jumping Flash!” “Pet in TV”) world design art.
Also the Demo version is available on Steam! We would like to hear your feedback!

Official Website: https://hungrymeem.com
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3051240
Steam Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3374230
Nintendo Switch: https://www.cloudedleopardent.com/game/meem/switch/en

Follow us for the latest news of the game!
Official X Account (Japanese): https://x.com/hungrymeem_JP
Official X Account (Global): https://x.com/hungrymeem
